subject: Post-call: Redwood + FintechCo — procurement & PO vs card
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@fintechco.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@fintechco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: Redwood + FintechCo — procurement & PO vs card

Hi Samantha / Tom — thanks again for the intro call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

What we heard
- Primary use case: customer support generation + routing for two product lines (low-latency inference, steady throughput).
- Success criteria: sub-250ms p99 for user-facing flows, predictable per-token cost to model budgets.
- Timeline: pilot in ~2–4 weeks; production decision after pilot (Q3 planning).

Procurement / commercial notes from the call
- FintechCo typically prefers purchase orders for production purchases.
- Credit card payments are sometimes allowed for POCs under $5k.
- Procurement will require standard vendor onboarding: W9, COI/insurance, vendor form, and potentially an SOW for larger engagements.
- Marketplace placement (AWS Marketplace) could simplify vendor onboarding / procurement for you — happy to explore.

Attachments I’m including
- Redwood_SOW_Template.pdf (editable SOW template)
- Redwood_W9.pdf
- Redwood_Sample_Invoice.pdf (example invoice format we can issue if you want to test PO flow)

Proposed next steps
1) Samantha / procurement: confirm whether you want to go PO for pilot or use card for a short POC (we recommend card for fastest POC; PO if you want to run immediately under contract).
2) If PO: please share vendor onboarding form and any specific PO terms (net X, invoice frequency). We will route to our finance team and return completed vendor form + insurance cert.
3) If card: we can set up a $3k POC purchase to validate latency/cost on your workloads; we’ll attach a sample invoice for your AP team.
4) I’ll loop in Ben (cc) who can provide procurement/commercial details and help with a PO-friendly invoice format.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call with procurement if that helps accelerate.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_Template.pdf, Redwood_W9.pdf, Redwood_Sample_Invoice.pdf
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: FintechCo Procurement <procurement@fintechco.com>
Date: 2026-07-21T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Redwood + FintechCo — procurement & PO vs card

Thanks Marissa — great summary and appreciated the docs. A few clarifying items from procurement side: 

1) Payment method: our AP policy is PO-first for any vendor spend expected to exceed $25k annually. For short trials or proof-of-concept we can often use a corporate credit card for amounts under $5k, which would be the fastest path to start.

2) Vendor onboarding: procurement@fintechco.com (cc’d) will need your W9, certificate of insurance (COI) with our company listed as additional insured, and a completed vendor onboarding form. Our onboarding form is linked here: https://fintechco.procure/vendor-form/12345 — please complete and return.

3) Terms: standard is net-30. If Redwood requires longer terms we will route to finance for approval, which can take 2–3 weeks.

4) Marketplace: we do prefer vendors in the AWS Marketplace where possible — reduces internal approvals. Are you guys listed or is that something you can help set up?

If you can send the W9 and sample invoice, procurement will confirm internal PO timeline. For a quick POC we’d be open to the $3k card payment; please confirm if that covers the pilot scope you recommend.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Head of Procurement Programs
FintechCo
samantha.lee@fintechco.com
From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@fintechco.com>
Date: 2026-07-21T11:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Redwood + FintechCo — procurement & PO vs card

Marissa / Samantha — looping in FintechCo finance context: 

- Vendor onboarding typically takes 7–21 business days depending on completeness of docs and insurance.
- For PO flow: we will generate a PO once the vendor is in the system and the SOW/invoice is approved; typical lead time is ~2–4 weeks to see the first PO if everything is in order.
- For card/P2P purchases under $5k we can do a one-off card charge; please confirm you accept card and provide the final purchase amount/invoice format.
- Preferred payment is ACH (bank details required on the invoice). If you do card, we will need the invoice afterward for reconciliation.

Requested from Redwood
- Completed vendor onboarding form (link Samantha included).
- W9 and COI (insurance).
- Example invoice (line items should separate subscription fees from professional services).

If you can provide those items this week we’ll start the onboarding and let you know expected PO ETA. Happy to take questions — procurement@fintechco.com is the intake for vendor docs.

Thanks,
Tom Alvarez
Sr. Manager, Finance Operations
FintechCo
tom.alvarez@fintechco.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@fintechco.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@fintechco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Redwood + FintechCo — procurement & PO vs card

Thanks Samantha / Tom — got it and appreciate the timelines. Quick reply with what we’ll do and next steps: 

1) For fastest time-to-value: we recommend the $3k card POC to validate latency and cost in your environment. If you confirm we will issue an invoice for $3,000.00 and accept card.
2) For PO path: we will complete your vendor form and return W9 + COI this week to procurement@fintechco.com (cc’d). We’ll also provide a draft SOW and a PO-friendly invoice template.
3) Marketplace: we are not currently listed in AWS Marketplace for this product tier, but we can prioritize a marketplace listing if that materially shortens your procurement process — that typically takes a few weeks to onboard.

I’m attaching the requested docs again and will fill out the vendor form today: Redwood_SOW_Template.pdf; Redwood_W9.pdf; Redwood_Sample_Invoice.pdf. Ben will coordinate with our finance ops on ACH details and the vendor form fields.

Action items
- Marissa / Ben: submit vendor onboarding form + W9 + COI to procurement@fintechco.com (ETA: EOD 2026-07-22).
- FintechCo: confirm whether you want to start with the $3k card POC or initiate PO onboarding for pilot.
- If card POC: FintechCo to send payment instructions and billing contact; Redwood to issue invoice and enable access.

Happy to hop on a quick 20-min call with procurement this week to unblock.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
